# QuotaPin 2.0.0-beta.2

This prerelease continues the 2.x placement work on the v1.2.1 stability baseline. It does not replace v1.2.1 as Latest and never enters QuotaPin's stable in-product update feed.

- Place quota in four verified surfaces: the account row, title center, workspace top, or above the composer. The inconsistent composer-side experiments have been retired and migrate safely to the account row.
- Hold anywhere inside the visible quota surface. The panel follows that real surface, and the original account row no longer keeps a hidden QuotaPin hold target after quota moves elsewhere.
- Drag modules at every supported position with the same exact pointer tracking, collision avoidance, neighbour spring, and left/center/right/module magnets used by the account row.
- Choose the account or composer quota line directly on the same work-surface map.
- Optionally show recent account-wide burn pace and estimated runway. The independent estimator uses only official remaining-percentage history, resets calibration at quota renewal, and waits for enough time and movement before reporting a value.
- Keep preview cohorts explicit: beta packages are installed by exact version and do not discover later betas through automatic or manual update checks.
- Migrate schema 18 configuration to schema 19 without enabling the new forecast modules or changing an existing stable placement.

## Exact-version install

Windows 10 version 2004 or later:

```powershell
& ([scriptblock]::Create((irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/WSL043/QuotaPin-for-Codex/main/install.ps1))) -Version '2.0.0-beta.2'
```

macOS:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/WSL043/QuotaPin-for-Codex/main/install-macos.sh | bash -s -- --version 2.0.0-beta.2
```

The reviewed public assets are `QuotaPin-2.0.0-beta.2.exe` and `QuotaPin-macOS-2.0.0-beta.2.dmg`. This beta is publishable only after the isolated product gates, the full cross-platform package workflow, and a local hot-update acceptance that preserves the running Codex process all pass.
